rule: only candidate output values plus the declared transformations below; basis is copied verbatim; everything else is unmapped

fields.transform: exact path equality with a fixture instance root, or the run book (a copy of instance-A)
copy; explicit null selection -> null; absent key -> unmapped
UNMAPPED: the candidate reports selected.rule = prime-desk-selector/1 but no selector path or hash; its selected.source is the work page, not the selection source

attention kind copied; gap kinds: stale|changed -> stale-source, missing -> missing-evidence, selector|catalog-not-chosen|same-address|packet-selection -> conflict, other -> coverage-gap; ref = address of the request work entry with the same path, else null
equal: the candidate has no overflow concept
null (no overflow concept in the candidate)
one row each, visible true; nothing else

status matched -> ok, stale|changed -> changed, missing -> absent; expected_sha256 from the request the adapter wrote; foreign read=false with another root -> outside-instance, path null (candidate gives address only)
director -> verbatim attributed 'Director'; model -> interpretation attributed 'model (unnamed in candidate output)'; quote_sha256 = sha256 of the quoted text bytes
rule_ref = gap.check; target_path = gap.path; target_instance instance-A
UNMAPPED: the candidate does not output claim/return/custody/review/disposition/approval/blocked/tails per work
UNMAPPED: the candidate lists catalog items but has no parallel concept with a basis
UNMAPPED: the candidate gives counts and a fixed text, not per-area coverage
UNMAPPED: recorded_state and supplied texts do not map to one state/basis without parsing text

conflicts: per case: selection-vs-canonical (selected.address vs assignment_reader fields.current_work joined by request path), canonical-unread-but-selected, same-path-different-hash
